plugins.name: emdash-guard
plugins.description: Post-write hook: counts em dashes and stand-in dashes in files Claude writes and shows the count, then fixes, ignores, or asks, per the /emdash-guard:autofix setting; /emdash-guard:hyphens can allow spaced hyphens as your own style.

plugins.name: commit-guard
plugins.description: Blocks git commits carrying a Co-Authored-By: Claude trailer, at the Claude tool layer, with a git commit-msg backstop you can install per repo.

plugins.name: commit-style
plugins.description: Guide, not a guard: warns (never blocks) when a commit subject is not Conventional Commits format. Installed as a per-repo commit-msg hook.

plugins.name: session-logger
plugins.description: Appends a per-day markdown log of each session: start, file writes, bash commands, and stop. Never blocks.

plugins.name: plugin-vet
plugins.description: Security-review a plugin before installing it: /plugin-vet:vet runs a deterministic malware scan of its hooks and scripts, then an AI review, with a BLOCK / WARN / CLEAN verdict.

plugins.name: push-guard
plugins.description: Refuses a git push whose commits carry secrets, credential files, conflict markers, or not-ready work. Tool-layer hook plus a git pre-push backstop you can install per repo.

plugins.name: pip-guard
plugins.description: Blocks pip installs into the global site-packages and points Claude at the project venv; stands down inside a venv/conda env, and PIP_GUARD_ALLOW=1 lets a user-approved global install through.

plugins.name: paste-guard
plugins.description: Stop hook: when a chat reply shows a shell snippet that would break in your login shell ($SHELL, e.g. bash-isms shown to a fish user), Claude re-emits the command natively. Scripts and tool calls are never touched.
